about_the_game:
The Tavern Keeper 🍻 - Supporter Pack 💚 includes the full high-quality Original Soundtrack, and (will in the future) unlock the in-game Developer Commentary.

During Early Access all players receive the Supporter Pack for free as a thank you for your early support!

Tavern Keeper 🍻 - Original Soundtrack

Composers Phil French and Tom Puttick of Cedar Studios (the team behind the soundtracks of Two Point Hospital™, Two Point Museum™, and more) take you on a feel-good tour through the world of Tavern Keeper.

Chill with the folky tunes of halflings, hum along to the dwarves' big-band brass, feel the orcs' backyard percussion, or get lost in the elves' refined harmonies.

Created over many years of close collaboration with Greenheart Games, the Original Soundtrack features 46 tracks across almost 2 hours of original music.

Available in high-quality lossless FLAC and MP3 formats.

Note: The Developer Commentary is not available yet at launch but will be made available throughout Early Access.
